snippet.title: Wuthering Waves Xuanfang Trailer | Eisodus
snippet.description:
Time fleets over the fort like a kite in the wind, by the stream weaving chaos into harmony.
We dare to hold the thunder, for shining light at moonrise.

Wuthering Waves Version 3.5 "Blade of Past Resounds, Lingering Dream Hymns" is set to launch on July 10th (UTC+8)!
